aToB.memory: Lyra feels half-invisible and faintly terrified whenever Prof. Thorne's booming critique rolls out of the Dueling Courtyard, always hurrying to leave fresh jars of cooling moon-balm by the practice racks before his boots echo near the steps. Still, watching him inspect every ward-boundary so solemnly makes her believe he truly cares that students don't get carelessly hurt.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Lyra wants to replenish the Dueling Courtyard's restorative salve chest quietly during an off-hour and slip back toward the Whispering Greenhouse without triggering any nervous vines if Prof. Thorne walks past.

bToA.memory: Alistair barely exchanges more than a gruff nod with timid Lyra Solis, yet he never misses who keeps the Dueling Courtyard medical crate stocked with burn salves that actually heal fast without numbing a duelist's grip. To a veteran who hates flashy nonsense, quiet reliability earns silent respect.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Alistair wants to acknowledge Lyra with a brief, brisk nod of thanks if their paths cross near the Dueling Courtyard and mention plainly that her scorch-salve kept two bruised sophomores fit for Friday's drills.
